_comment: MusicD-Server-v1 update manifest (v1.1.3.8). Served to running servers from
https://raw.githubusercontent.com/meltface-80/MusicD-Server-v1/main/manifest.json
and read by musicd/server/src/remoteUpdater.js. Editing this file IS publishing
a release: the URL is stable for the life of the project, the contents change.
Shape: hybrid (see musicd/CHANGELOG.md, v1.1.1.3). The top-level version/tarUrl
pair is what pre-v1.1.1.3 servers read; manifestVersion + channels is what
v1.1.1.3+ servers read once the user has picked a channel. Both must be kept in
step. camelCase keys are the ones this server actually reads; the snake_case
aliases (tarball_url, tarball_sha256, released_at, release_notes_url) mirror the
MusicD-Server-Bridge manifest so a bridge-style reader understands this file too.
INTEGRITY: tarSha256 / tarball_sha256 are null because the tar is built and
committed after this manifest is written. null means 'no hash published' and the
updater skips hash verification for that download (it still enforces the size cap,
the too-small/HTML check and the ustar magic check). To turn verification on, run
sha256sum musicd-v1-1-34-0.tar
and paste the hex into tarSha256 and tarball_sha256 below. Do NOT put a dummy
64-hex placeholder here: the updater cannot tell a placeholder from a real hash
and would refuse every download.
accessTiers carries the four code-bearing tiers only. Demo has no code and, since
v1.1.3.8, no longer depends on the manifest at all (tierConfig.DEFAULT_TIER is the
floor). codeHash is sha256('musicd-v1-tier-' + code) — see tierConfig.hashCode.
Dropping this block makes POST /api/update/tier/code answer 503 and the four codes
stop working, so it must be carried across on every release.
releaseNotes: Album matching now works from artist and album title alone - an exact match on both used to score just under the threshold and get sent to triage, which is why remasters and deluxe editions kept failing. It also resolves the artist to a MusicBrainz id first and reads their real discography, and recovers a missing artist or title from the tracks or the folder name. New: Settings > Library > Group album versions collapses the original, the deluxe and the remaster into one tile showing the best quality copy you own; nothing is merged or deleted. Fixed: Qobuz and Tidal favourites are no longer capped at 5000, the streaming album grids match the main library's sizing, and Play and Add Queue sit side by side on tablets as well as phones.
